They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Nina advised Grace to try reading as a new hobby. The children showed their love with drawings.
On Sunday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Grace plans to study history harder this term. Let the curry simmer gently.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Grace will take part in a volleyball match in February. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. He gave a pained smile when asked about his knee.

Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The spring market has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. For example, the norwegian fjords attract tourists every summer.
Little by little, things began to change. The gift box looked quieter than usual that evening. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
